2609.03923.title: Speak for Me: Giving LLMs the Situational Awareness to Participate in a Meeting
2609.03923.paper_summary: In online meeting delegation, LLM agents fail to recognize when to speak. With no structured way to track stances, coverage, and floor, they miss the moments where they should contribute. Prompt-only delegates stay silent on 51.4% of the absent participant's talking opportunities on the AMI corpus. We present CAPA (Collaborative Agent Predictive Architecture), an architecture for online meeting delegation. A Perceiver updates the meeting state from each observed turn. A Predictor forecasts how the conversation will continue. A Controller decides whether to speak and which proposition to surface. A Generator phrases the chosen contribution in the participant's style. Two judges score the forecast and the action against the next observed turn. A Recalibrator updates the meeting state from those verdicts for future decisions. To evaluate online delegation, we introduce an episode-level protocol that scores whether, when, and what a delegate contributes around the participant's actual idea units. The protocol's schema-constrained LLM judges align with human annotations at Cohen's kappa = 0.71. On 137 AMI meetings, CAPA reduces the silence rate from 51.4% to 2.5%, doubles credited recovery (26.1 --> 52.2), and keeps hallucination at 0.6%. The failure mode shifts from omission to selection, with each residual near-miss attributable to a specific module of the architecture. Mechanism ablations identify the meeting state as the lever that closes the recognition gap, where raw-context scaling alone does not.
2609.03923.paper_summary_zh: 在在線會議委派中，LLM 代理無法識別何時發言。由於沒有結構化的方法來跟蹤立場、覆蓋範圍和發言權，他們錯過了應該貢獻的時刻。僅依賴提示的代表在 AMI 語料庫中對缺席參與者的談話機會保持沉默達 51.4%。我們提出了 CAPA（協作代理預測架構），這是一種在線會議委派的架構。一個感知器從每個觀察到的回合更新會議狀態。一個預測器預測對話將如何繼續。一個控制器決定是否發言以及提出哪個主張。一個生成器以參與者的風格措辭所選的貢獻。兩位評審根據下一個觀察到的回合對預測和行動進行評分。一個重新校準器根據這些判決更新會議狀態以便未來的決策。為了評估在線委派，我們引入了一個事件級別的協議，評分代表在參與者的實際思想單位周圍貢獻的是否、何時和什麼。該協議的架構約束 LLM 評審與人類註釋的對齊程度為 Cohen's kappa = 0.71。在 137 次 AMI 會議中，CAPA 將沉默率從 51.4% 降低到 2.5%，使得獲得的恢復翻倍（26.1 --> 52.2），並將幻覺保持在 0.6%。失敗模式從遺漏轉變為選擇，每個殘留的近失都可歸因於架構的特定模塊。機制消融確定會議狀態是縮小識別差距的杠杆，而僅僅依賴原始上下文的擴展則無法達到。
